_doc: The new-game intro (ADR-0064): cards played in order by IntroPlayer. kind: caption (a stamp line and typed lines on black), document (a typed paper form with a rubber stamp), radio (a transcript, line by line: 'SPEAKER|text'), impact (the crash: a shake, a flash and sounds, then the lines), world (a picture of `poi`'s built instance, else of `at` [x, z], from the `from`/`to` framing, rendered offline by `make stills` and zoomed in slowly (ADR-0065); a caption on black without it), title (the game's name). hold: seconds a card stays once fully shown. sound: played when the card starts; caption: its words when sound captions are on (Options) (UI bus; impact cards may list several in 'sounds'). {day} {time} {hum_in} are filled from the session; {place} is the drop site's region once the world is up (THE TIMBER before). The owner's lore call (2026-10-08): the intro shows #4471's drop aircraft going down short of the drop site; the outbreak's cause is never told here: only what a convict on that flight would know (the Program's deal, the Cordon, rumours, the drop briefing), with hints but no answers (the player finds the cause in the world). Names, dates and numbers follow docs/LORE_TRAIL.md (Order 14 on Sept 1; Lifts 1 and 2 already lost; #4471 arrives in Year 2's autumn).

lines: A year ago the Cordon closed every road off the mountain.
The stories that came out after didn't agree on much. Only that the people in there were still walking.
That the ground hums every seventh night.
That on those nights, whatever is still walking in there comes for the brightest fire it can hear.
cards.caption: [a low hum, deep in the ground]

cards.heading: ORDER 14 — NOTICE OF CLOSURE
lines: Effective September 1: Route 9 and every road out of the Hollowmere valley are closed.
Hazard: biological, unidentified.
Fence, drones, a burned firebreak: the Cordon. No one comes out who has not been cleared.
Residents who fled to the high timber are not to be approached.
cards.caption: [a page turns]

cards.heading: REMAND SALVAGE PROGRAM — ENROLMENT
lines: Salvager No. 4471. Year 2 intake.
Duty: recover samples and field records from inside the Cordon.
Each delivery to Waystation 9 shortens your sentence.
The tether on your wrist stays locked. It will tell you when the ground is due to hum.
cards.caption: [a page turns]

cards.heading: DROP BRIEFING — LIFT 3
lines: Drop site: Larch Hollow, sector D6. At first light.
Pell's Crossing (abandoned) is a short walk north-east. Waystation 9 is at the river gate.
Corvane Mining property is out of bounds. Do not ask why.
Do not travel at night. Do not light what you cannot put out.
cards.caption: [a page turns]

cards.heading: CORDON CONTROL  ·  CH 4  ·  05:41
lines: LIFT 3|Control, Lift Three, over the firebreak. One salvager for Larch Hollow.
CONTROL|Copy, Three. Wind light from the west.
LIFT 3|Ground's moving down there. Whole treeline shaking, no wind —
LIFT 3|Losing number two. Losing height.
CONTROL|Three, say again?
LIFT 3|Mayday, mayday, Lift Three going in short of the drop —
cards.caption: [radio static]
[an engine screams; trees break; metal tears]

cards.heading: CORDON CONTROL  ·  CH 4  ·  05:44
lines: CONTROL|Lift Three, Control.
CONTROL|Lift Three, Control. Respond.
CONTROL|...Log it. That's three lifts. Tether 4471 still reads a pulse. Waystation 9 out.
cards.caption: [radio static]

lines: The wreck burned out before first light. Nobody came for it.
You walked the last mile to the drop site with the tether ticking.
{hum_in}
The valley breathes on the seventh night.
